selection_conditioning: No postselection in the primary benchmark; random-unitary controls are CPTP.
interface_state: Binary d0/d1 label included in the enlarged Hilbert space.
active_control_route: Generator identity and all control parameters frozen before simulation.
calibration_and_units: Probabilities and multinomial counts; symmetric detector confusion matrix is explicit.

conservation_exchange_ledger.probability: Trace preserved globally and by declared CPTP controls.
conservation_exchange_ledger.energy: Not modeled; no energy-conservation claim is made.
conservation_exchange_ledger.charge: Not modeled; no charge-conservation claim is made.
conservation_exchange_ledger.entropy: No reduced-subsystem entropy conservation claim is made.
conservation_exchange_ledger.accessible_information: Protocol-dependent; local and sector-complete values are reported separately.

unresolved_sector_bounds: No real string/Wilson measurement is represented.
No real topological-defect Hamiltonian is represented.
No calorimetric energy scale is represented.
model_mediated_inversion: Pure-generator likelihood classification, exact equivalence classes, Fisher rank, and mutual information.

null_directions: Local observation has an absorb-versus-string null direction.

rejection_test: Reject the four-pure-generator candidate set when its selection-adjusted diagnostic upper bound is below 0.001.
